title: 第21章 过年旅行-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    之后的日子，王建新每天就是修炼功法、练习法术。

    炼气三层的底子越来越扎实。灵气在体内运转得越来越顺畅，丹田里的灵气雾越来越浓，像一团白色的云，盘在小腹位置。三个法术也越来越熟练——火球术想大就大想小就小，风刃术想长就长想短就短，冰锥术想快就快想慢就慢。他在河边立了几根木桩当靶子，每天练上几十次，准头越来越好。火球能精准地打在靶心，风刃能把木桩切成两半，冰锥能钉在同一个点上。

    这天，王建新吃完饭，从空间里出来，开始巡边。

    大雪过后，草原上白茫茫的一片。雪没化，冻得硬邦邦的，踩上去嘎吱嘎吱响。风不大，但冷，零下二十几度，呼出的气瞬间结成白雾。王建新裹着蒙古袍，骑着青马，慢悠悠地沿着铁丝网走。

    大毛到五毛在雪地里撒着欢。五个家伙在空间里养了这么久，一个个长得跟小牛犊子似的，膘肥体壮，毛色发亮。见了雪比见了肉还亲，在雪地里打滚、刨坑、互相追咬，闹得雪沫子乱飞。大毛最稳当，不跟它们疯，跟在马后面小跑，时不时抬头看看王建新。五毛最皮，一会儿咬二毛的尾巴，一会儿追三毛四毛，跑得气喘吁吁也不歇。

    王建新骑着马，溜溜达达地巡边。铁丝网被雪埋了大半截，只露出上面几道铁丝，在风里呜呜地响。对面还是老样子，安安静静的，连个人影都没有。自从乌兰巴托那档子事以后，对面的巡逻就加强了几天，后来就松懈了，也不知道是因为没吃的，还是觉得他这里是最不可能出事的地方。

    他抬头看了看天。天灰蒙蒙的，云层很低，压得人有点闷。

    “马上过年了。”王建新心里算了一下，腊月二十几了，再有几天就是除夕。

    他想起京城，想起父母、大哥大嫂、二哥、小妹。不知道他们最近怎么样？父亲的风湿病冬天会不会犯？母亲的胃病好些了没有？大哥开车冬天路滑，安不安全？二哥在厂里累不累？小妹长高了吧？

    想到过年自己一个人在这茫茫草原上，连个说话的人也没有，王建新心里确实有点孤单。

    “没办法，谁让咱是修仙者呢？”他自嘲地笑了笑。

    修仙者也是人啊，也想过年，也想吃顿团圆饭，也想听听鞭炮声，也想跟家里人围在一起唠唠嗑。但这些，现在都是奢望。

    “也不知道多会儿能回城。”王建新看了看远方，白茫茫的草原延伸到天边，看不见头。

    算了，不想那么多了。想多了也没用，该回的时候自然就回了。

    他继续巡边。

    骑着马沿着铁丝网往北走，走到头了，掉头往回走。走到一半的时候，他远远地看见一群什么东西在雪地上移动。炼气三层的视力好，他眯着眼看了看——黄羊。

    一群黄羊，大概三十多头，正在雪地上觅食。黄羊的毛色跟冬天的草原差不多，灰黄灰黄的，不仔细看还真看不出来。它们在雪地里刨草根吃，低着头，慢悠悠地往他这个方向移动。

    王建新心里一动。

    心念一闪，狙击步枪从空间里出来了，稳稳地端在手里。SVD狙击步枪，带瞄准镜，从哈登堡勒格那个办公室衣柜里收来的，他一直保养得很好，枪身擦得锃亮。

    “大毛、二毛、三毛、四毛、五毛。”王建新低声喊了一句。

    五个家伙在空间里长大，确实聪明。一听他这语气，立马就不闹了。大毛低吼了一声，五个家伙齐刷刷地趴下，趴在雪地里，一动不动，一声不吭。毛色跟雪地不太搭，但趴着不动也不显眼。

    王建新翻身下马，把青马收入空间。然后端着枪，蹲在雪地里，瞄准镜对准了远处那群黄羊。

    黄羊群慢慢地往他这个方向移动。它们很警惕，走几步就抬起头来看看四周，耳朵转来转去。但风是从对面吹过来的，把王建新的气味吹走了，黄羊闻不到。

    距离越来越近。五百米，四百米，三百米……

    王建新趴在雪地里，一动不动。炼气三层的身体稳得像块石头，枪端在手里纹丝不动。呼吸放慢了，心跳放慢了，整个世界都安静下来，只剩下瞄准镜里那群黄羊。

    距离差不多了。两百米左右。

    王建新扣动了扳机。

    “砰——”

    枪声在空旷的草原上炸开，回音传出去老远。瞄准镜里，一头大公羊应声倒下，在雪地里蹬了几下腿就不动了。

    黄羊群炸了锅，四散奔逃。但王建新没给它们机会。他拉枪栓，退壳，上膛，瞄准，扣扳机，一气呵成。一枪接着一枪，枪声在草原上密集地响起来。

    一枪，两枪，三枪，四枪……

    弹壳从枪膛里跳出来，落在雪地里，冒着热气。王建新的手稳得很，每一枪都带走一头黄羊。打了十几枪，他停了手。

    远处，剩下的黄羊早已跑得没影了，只留下一串蹄印在雪地上延伸到天边。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the days that followed, Wang Jianxin practiced exercises and spells every day.

The foundation of the third level of Qi refining is getting more and more solid.The spiritual energy circulates more and more smoothly in the body, and the spiritual energy mist in the Dantian becomes thicker and thicker, like a white cloud, coiled in the lower abdomen.The three spells are becoming more and more proficient - the fireball technique can be as big as you want, the wind blade technique can be as long as you want, as short as you want, and the ice cone technique can be as fast as you want, as slow as you want.He set up a few wooden stakes by the river as targets and practiced dozens of times a day, and his accuracy became better and better.Fireballs can hit the target with precision, wind blades can cut wooden stakes in half, and ice picks can nail the same spot.

On this day, after Wang Jianxin finished eating, he came out of the space and began to patrol the area.

After the heavy snow, the grassland is completely white.The snow hasn't melted yet, but it's still freezing and makes a crunching sound when you step on it.The wind was not strong, but it was cold, more than 20 degrees below zero, and the breath instantly turned into white mist.Wang Jianxin was wrapped in a Mongolian robe, riding a green horse, and walked slowly along the barbed wire fence.

From big to five cents, they were having fun in the snow.The five guys have been raised in the space for so long, and each of them looks like a calf, fat and strong, with shiny coat.They were closer to each other than to flesh. They rolled around in the snow, dug holes, and chased and bit each other, causing snow foam to fly everywhere.Da Mao was the most stable and did not go crazy with them. He trotted behind the horses and looked up at Wang Jianxin from time to time.Wu Mao is the skinniest. Now he bites Er Mao's tail, and now he chases San Mao and Si Mao. He runs until he is panting and doesn't stop.

Wang Jianxin rode a horse and strolled around the border.Most of the barbed wire fence was buried in the snow, and only a few wires were exposed, whining in the wind.The opposite side was still the same, quiet and quiet, not even a single person in sight.Since the incident in Ulaanbaatar, the patrols on the opposite side had been intensified for a few days, and then relaxed. I don't know whether it was because he had no food, or because he felt that this was the place where he was least likely to have an accident.

He looked up at the sky.The sky was gray and the clouds were very low, making it a bit boring.

"The New Year is coming soon." Wang Jianxin calculated in his mind that it was already the twenties of the twelfth lunar month, and New Year's Eve would be in a few days.

He thought of the capital, his parents, his elder brother and sister-in-law, his second brother and his younger sister.I wonder how they are doing lately?Will my father's rheumatism relapse in winter?Is your mother's stomach problem getting better?Brother, is it safe to drive on slippery roads in winter?Second brother, are you tired from working in the factory?Has my little sister grown taller?

Thinking about being alone in this vast grassland during the Chinese New Year, with no one to talk to, Wang Jianxin did feel a little lonely.

"There is no way, who makes us cultivators of immortality?" He smiled mockingly.

Immortal cultivators are also human beings. They also want to celebrate the New Year, have a reunion dinner, listen to the sound of firecrackers, and chat with their family members.But these are all extravagant hopes now.

“I don’t know how long it will take to return to the city.” Wang Jianxin looked into the distance. The vast white grassland stretched to the horizon with no end in sight.

Forget it, I don’t want to think about it that much.There's no point in thinking too much, I'll just go back when it's time.

He continued to patrol the border.

Riding a horse and walking north along the barbed wire fence, when you reach the end, turn around and go back.Halfway through, he saw a group of things moving on the snow in the distance.The third level of Qi Refining had good eyesight, so he squinted and looked at Huang Yang.

A group of about thirty yellow sheep are foraging on the snow.The color of the yellow sheep's coat is similar to that of winter grassland, gray and yellow, and you really can't tell it unless you look carefully.They were digging for grass roots in the snow, lowering their heads and moving slowly in his direction.

Wang Jianxin's heart moved.

With a flash of thought, the sniper rifle came out of the space and was held steadily in his hand.The SVD sniper rifle, with scope, was collected from the closet in Hardenberg Lege's office. He had always maintained it very well, and the gun body was polished.

"Big hair, two cents, three cents, four cents, five cents." Wang Jianxin shouted in a low voice.

Five guys grew up in space, they are indeed smart.As soon as I heard his tone, I immediately stopped making trouble.Da Mao let out a low roar, and the five guys all fell down in the snow, motionless and silent.The coat color doesn't match the snow, but it doesn't stand out even when lying still.

Wang Jianxin dismounted and put the green horse into the space.Then he squatted in the snow with the gun in his hand, aiming the scope at the group of yellow sheep in the distance.

The yellow sheep herd slowly moved in his direction.They are very alert. After taking a few steps, they will raise their heads and look around, and their ears will turn back and forth.But the wind blew from the opposite side and blew Wang Jianxin's smell away, making it impossible for the Yellow Sheep to smell it.

The distance is getting closer.Five hundred meters, four hundred meters, three hundred meters...

Wang Jianxin lay motionless in the snow.The body at the third level of Qi Refining was as stable as a stone, and the gun tip was motionless in his hand.Breathing slowed down, heartbeat slowed down, and the whole world became quiet except for the group of yellow sheep in the scope.

The distance is almost there.About two hundred meters.

Wang Jianxin pulled the trigger.

"Bang——"

The sound of gunshots exploded in the open grassland, and the echoes spread far and wide.In the scope, a big ram fell down, kicked its legs in the snow a few times and then stopped moving.

The yellow sheep group exploded and fled in all directions.But Wang Jianxin didn't give them a chance.He pulled the bolt, unloaded the gun, loaded the gun, aimed, and pulled the trigger, all in one go.Shot after shot, gunshots rang out densely on the grassland.

One shot, two shots, three shots, four shots...

The bullet casing jumped out of the gun chamber and fell to the snow, steaming.Wang Jianxin's hand was very steady, and he took away a yellow sheep with every shot.After firing more than a dozen shots, he stopped.

In the distance, the remaining yellow sheep had already disappeared, leaving only a string of hoof prints on the snow extending to the horizon.

title_en: Chapter 21 Chinese New Year Travel - "At the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune from zero-yuan purchases"
